requirements.text: When a fault case is logged for a site that already had two or more fault cases in the last 30 days, the case is marked as a repeat fault with the count, so repeat problems get a senior look.
acceptance: Third fault at HV-B within 30 days: Repeat fault = Yes, Repeat count = 3
Complaints, requests and questions never count
Cases older than 30 days or cancelled do not count
Marked at creation, before the case reaches a queue

requirements.text: When I open a repeat-fault case I see a warning with the count and a link to the site's recent cases.
acceptance: Warning notification on the Case main form (Cedar) when Repeat fault = Yes
No warning otherwise; no extra Web API call when the columns are on the form

requirements.text: Work orders for repeat-fault cases ask FieldLink for a senior technician.
acceptance: Outbound job message includes seniorTechnician true for repeat-fault cases, false otherwise
Contract version 1.1.0, additive; FieldLink sandbox accepts both 1.0 and 1.1 messages

requirements.text: A view and chart of repeat-fault cases per site for the last 90 days.
acceptance: View Repeat faults – last 90 days on Case, chart by Site, on the Cedar Service Overview dashboard

requirements.text: The site contact receives an e-mail when the subcontractor arrives on site.
acceptance: E-mail within 5 minutes of the cedar_OnSubcontractorArrived event
Only to the site's primary contact; no e-mail when the contact has opted out (Do not allow Emails)

requirements.target: Case create p75 increases by at most 200 ms; repeat-fault plug-in step at most 200 ms (C-61 budget)
acceptance: Measured in Cedar-Test with the C-62 test profile before and after

requirements.target: Repeat-fault plug-in failures or arrival e-mail failures alert within 60 minutes
acceptance: Alert rules in the C-20 catalogue with owner and runbook

requirements.text: No customer contact data leaves Cedar for FieldLink
requirements.target: 0 personal contact fields in the FieldLink contract
acceptance: Contract schema test and threat TH-15 unchanged

components.name: Case columns Repeat fault cedar_repeatfault and Repeat count cedar_repeatcount
RepeatFaultPlugin (PreOperation, Create of incident, synchronous)
components.identity: Calling user (plug-in runs in the user's context; reads cases the user may not see through a system-user query)
components.why: Needs a count of related rows at creation time, before routing; rollup columns recalculate asynchronously (up to 12 h) and a business rule cannot query related rows; a flow runs after creation, too late for routing.

components.name: Repeat-fault form notification (extension of C-19 client script)
components.monitoring: none: client-only, errors visible to the user; covered by the E2E smoke
components.why: A business rule can show an error or recommendation but not a dismissible form-level warning with a link; the logic is three lines in the existing C-19 library.

components.name: FieldLink contract 1.1.0: seniorTechnician in the job message
components.identity: func-cedar-fieldlink managed identity (reads the case), FieldLink client credential (sends)

components.name: View Repeat faults – last 90 days and chart on Cedar Service Overview
Cloud flow Cedar – Arrival notice (business event trigger)
components.identity: Connection reference cedar_DataverseAutomation (Cedar Automation service principal) and cedar_OutlookNotifications (shared mailbox)

components.name: Alerts AL-12 repeat-fault plug-in failures and AL-13 arrival notice failures
components.identity: Azure Monitor alert rules, action group ag-cedar-integration
